comparisons.criterion: halton mean MSE is strictly less than counter mean MSE

equal_time.process_overhead_definition: process_elapsed_ms - render_loop_wall_ms; non-render process overhead includes startup, scene/asset loading, upload, download, image/raw/metadata output, and process teardown; it is not labeled renderer setup time
equal_time.time_budget_note: the budget is checked between whole samples; no upper-bound assertion excludes one-sample overshoot

pooled_mse.pooling: arithmetic mean of per-render linear-RGB per-channel pixel MSE; all fixed candidate images have identical dimensions

qualification.note: inadequate references force an inconclusive result regardless of the observed candidate ordering

attempts.criterion: split_reference_rmse <= 0.25 * min(mean(candidate RMSE at 256 spp, counter), mean(candidate RMSE at 256 spp, halton))
